Update Information

更新情報

Portal 2 - Update 2

Access to online features has been removed.
Continue to join us online in the free version of SingStar™
that is available on the XMB™ Menu or PlayStation®Store.
All of the below disc features are already available via the free version of SingStar™
- Access to the SingStore™
- Download of previously purchased content (including song add-ons)
- Uploading of snapshots and video playback
- Viewing and rating of uploaded media

Access to online features has been removed.
Continue to join us online in the free version of SingStar™
that is available on the XMB™ Menu or PlayStation®Store.
All of the below disc features are already available via the free version of SingStar™
- Access to the SingStore™
- Download of previously purchased content (including song add-ons)
- Uploading of snapshots and video playback
- Viewing and rating of uploaded media

L'accès aux fonctions en ligne a été supprimé.
Rejoins-nous en ligne avec la version gratuite de SingStar®
disponible depuis le menu XMB™ ou PlayStation®Store.
Les fonctions ci-dessous sont déjà disponibles dans la version gratuite de SingStar™ :
- Accès au SingStore™
- Téléchargement des contenus achetés précédemment (dont les packs de chansons)
- Envoi des captures d'écran et des vidéos
- Affichage et notation des médias envoyés

Se ha eliminado el acceso a las funciones online.
Continúa uniéndote a nosotros online en la versión sin coste alguno de SingStar®
disponible en el menú XMB™ (XrossMediaBar) o en PlayStation®Store.
Todas las funciones de disco de abajo ya están disponibles en la versión sin coste alguno de SingStar®:
- Acceso a SingStore®
- Descarga de contenido adquirido previamente (incluyendo funciones de canciones)
- Carga de fotografías y reproducciones de vídeo
- Visionado y calificación de medios cargados

Die Zugangsberechtigung zu den Online-Funktionen wurde entfernt.
Bleibe mit der kostenlosen Version von SingStar®,
verfügbar im XMB™ (XrossMediaBar)-Menü oder in PlayStation®Store, weiterhin online an unserer Seite.
Alle der unten genannten Punkte sind bereits mit der kostenlosen Version von SingStar™ verfügbar:
- Zugang zum SingStore™
- Herunterladen zuvor gekaufter Inhalte (auch Song-Erweiterungen)
- Hochladen von Schnappschüssen und Video-Wiederholungen
- Ansehen und Bewerten hochgeladener Medien

Rimosso l'accesso alle funzioni online.
Continuate a giocare online con la versione gratuita di SingStar®
accedendo dal menu XMB™ o da PlayStation®Store.
Tutti i contenuti del disco elencati qui di seguito sono già disponibili nella versione gratuita di SingStar™:
- Accesso a SingStore™
- Download dei contenuti già acquistati (inclusi i brani aggiuntivi)
- Caricamento di istantanee e playback video
- Visualizzazione e valutazione dei media caricati

De toegang tot online-functies is verwijderd.
Je kunt online met ons doorgaan in de gratis versie van SingStar®
die beschikbaar is in het XMB™-menu of de PlayStation®Store.
De volgende disc-functies zijn al beschikbaar via de gratis versie van SingStar®:
- Toegang tot de SingStore®
- Download van eerder gekochte inhoud (inclusief extra nummers)
- Uploaden van foto's en beeldopnamen
- Bekijken en beoordelen van geüploade media

O acesso a funcionalidades online foi removido.
Continua a juntar-te a nós online através da versão gratuita do SingStar®,
disponível no Menu XMB™ ou na PlayStation®Store.
As seguintes funcionalidades de disco já se encontram disponíveis através da versão gratuita do SingStar™:
- Acesso à SingStore™
- Transferência de conteúdos comprados anteriormente (incluindo add-ons de canções)
- Envio de fotografias e reproduções de vídeos
- Visualização e classificação de media enviados

Доступ к сетевым возможностям был закрыт.
Присоединиться к нам в сети вы можете с помощью бесплатной версии SingStar®,
доступной в меню XMB и PlayStation®Store.
Все нижеперечисленные возможности дисковой версии также присутствуют в бесплатной версии SingStar™:
- Доступ к магазину SingStore™.
- Загрузка ранее приобретенных материалов (включая песни из дополнений).
- Публикация снимков и видео.
- Просмотр и оценивание опубликованных материалов.

Pääsy online-ominaisuuksiin on poistettu.
Voit jatkaa online-käyttöä SingStar®-pelin ilmaisversiolla,
joka on saatavilla XMB™-valikosta tai PlayStation®Store-verkkokaupasta.
Kaikki alla olevat ominaisuudet ovat valmiina käytettävissä SingStar™-pelin ilmaisversiossa:
- Pääsy SingStore™-verkkokauppaan
- Aiemmin ostetun sisällön (mukaan lukien lisäkappaleet) lataaminen
- Kuvien ja videoiden lähettäminen
- Lähetetyn aineiston katseleminen ja arvosteleminen

Tillgång till onlinefunktioner har tagits bort.
Fortsätt att vara med oss online med gratisversionen av SingStar®
som finns tillgänglig i XMB™-menyn och PlayStation®Store.
Alla nedanstående funktioner från skivversioner av spelet finns redan tillgängliga i gratisversionen av SingStar™:
- Tillgång till SingStore™
- Nedladdning av tidigare köpt innehåll (inklusive låttillägg)
- Uppladdning av foton och videoinspelningar
- Visning och betygsättning av uppladdade media

Adgang til onlinefunktioner er fjernet.
Du kan stadig slutte dig til os online i den gratis version af SingStar®,
der er tilgængelig i XMB™-menuen eller PlayStation®Store.
Alle de diskfunktioner, der beskrives nedenfor, er allerede tilgængelige i den gratis version af SingStar™:
- Adgang til SingStore™
- Download af indhold, du tidligere har købt (inklusive sangtilføjelser)
- Upload af snapshots og videoafspilninger
- Visning og vurdering af uploadede medier

Tilgang til online-funksjoner er fjernet.
Du kan fremdeles gå online med gratisversjonen av SingStar®
som du finner på XMB™-menyen og i PlayStation®Store.
Alt av diskinnhold og -funksjoner nedenfor er allerede tilgjengelig via gratisversjonen av SingStar™:
- Tilgang til SingStore™
- Nedlasting av tidligere kjøpt innhold (deriblant sangtillegg)
- Opplasting av bilder og avspilling av video
- Se og ranger opplastet medieinnhold

Dostęp do funkcji sieciowych został wyłączony.
Dołącz do nas w sieci w bezpłatnej wersji SingStar®,
dostępnej w menu XMB lub PlayStation®Store.
Wszystkie poniższe funkcje dyskowe są już dostępne w bezpłatnej wersji SingStar™:
- Dostęp do SingStore™
- Pobieranie uprzednio zakupionej zawartości (w tym piosenek dodatkowych)
- Przesyłanie zdjęć i klipów
- Wyświetlanie i ocenianie przesłanych materiałów

O acesso aos recursos online foi removido.
Continue a entrar online na versão gratuita de SingStar®,
disponível no menu XMB™ ou na PlayStation®Store.
Todos os recursos do disco abaixo já estão disponíveis na versão gratuita do SingStar™:
- Acesso à SingStore™
- Baixar conteúdo adquirido previamente (incluindo complementos de músicas)
- Envio de instantâneos e reproduções de vídeo
- Visualização e classificação de mídia enviada

・『設定』で、キャラクターチェンジの操作を、右スティックの「左右」「上下反転」「左右反転」での操作に変更可能になります。
・『設定』で、名品・逸品の文字の濃さが変更できるようになります。
・エナジーフレームのソートと並び替え機能が追加されます。
・エナジーフレーム画面の装備スロットで、『捨てる』『保護』の選択が可能になります。
・ジュークボックスにオープニング曲が登場します。
・エナジーフレームで『情報切り替え』をした後にカーソルを動かしても、情報が保持されるようになります。
・ダンジョン内で仮取得中の装備品を確認した時に、SELECTボタンで目印を付けられるようになります。
・エディットキャラクターの名前が7文字まで入力可能になります。
・モンスター図鑑に撃破数の項目が追加掲載されるようになります。
・シナリオクリア後、レイルヤードにいるキャラクターの台詞が変化します。
・おえかき時の「別キャラからコピー」のサンプルに、以下のキャラクターのデータが追加されます。
『ラハール』『エトナ』『フロン』『プリニー』『アデル』『ロザリンド』『マオ』『ラズベリル』
『ヴァルバトーゼ』『風祭フーカ』『エミーゼル』『ギグ』『キサラギ』『アリス』『トモエ』『ラン』
『シン』『ユコ』『サコ』
・ランジョン系90～100階での黒のカギの出現率が上がります。
・ルール「消費アイテムか名品しか落ちない」が発動している時の黒のカギの出現率が上がります。
・線路探索で手がかりを発見した時の効果量が上がります。
・そのほかゲームシステムの調整がされます。

changelogs.content:
Ver. 1.01
Important Notice
When using a version of "DYNASTY WARRIORS 7 Empires" for which this update has not been applied (Ver. 1.00),
 please refrain from loading play data or system data that was created after applying this update.
 (Save data that was created before applying the update can be used without issue even after applying the update.)

The following features were added:
 - Test Battle was added to Edit Mode.
  (Stratagems can be used for testing, but Plots cannot be selected.)
 - The number of colors that can be selected for hair in Edit Mode has been expanded to 256.
 - Strengthened the influence of play histories recorded by created officers.
  (The content of play history data is not changed from that of Ver. 1.00.)
 - The following options have been added to the initial settings for Empire Mode:
  (The options can be used after clearing Empire Mode.)
   - Randomization of NPC default Fame.
   - Basic Fame level for created NPC officers.
 - Added the Strategy command "Depart".
 (The command can only be used when you are affiliated with a force as a subordinate. Rulers cannot use it.)
 - The progress of missions is now displayed in the mission info of the Strategy screen.
 - For NPC forces, the NPC's that take on positions such as Strategists and Marshals will now change.
 - When switching the camera at your Abode, the camera's previous position will now be remembered.
 - Added functionality to the L2 button to enable players to give orders to their entire force during battle.
  (This can only be used in situations for which the command "Give Orders" can be used.)
 - Added General Order to the "Give Orders" command on the Information Screen during battle.
 - Reduced the possibility of sworn siblings and spouses becoming a commander during battle.
 - Adjusted the amount that attack power is raised for the Stratagems "Immovable" and "Peerless".
 - "Meat Buns" now appear when defeating enemies during Surprise Attacks.
 - Increased the number of events in which allied NPC officers speak lines.
 - When captured officers are released, they will now return to their former forces if possible.
 - Adjusted conversations that occur as a result of Friendship levels.
The following issues were corrected:
 - Corrected an issue in which under certain conditions the game would stop or could not be advanced during the Strategy Phase
 - Corrected an issue in which under certain conditions the game would stop during battle.
 - Corrected an issue in which the faces of officers were not displayed for conversations during the Strategy Phase.
 - Corrected an issue in which ability values were incorrectly increased when using "Unlock Items".
 - Corrected an issue in which, when the player received weapon attacks that latch onto the player,
    such as standard great axe attacks, such weapons were not displayed correctly.
 - Corrected a number of other graphical issues.

【Ver.1.13　アップデート内容】

　・高難度チャレンジシナリオに「臥薪嘗胆」を追加

　・オンラインプレイ時のポップアップ

　・争覇モードのシナリオ「英雄集結」にて、武将選択画面で特定の操作を行うと進行不能になることがある
　・全軍指示を繰り返すと武将が登場しなくなることがある
　・その他、いくつかの不具合を修正

Ragnarok Odyssey ACE
Ver 1.11

Updating Information
  ・Addition of "Jester Hat" and "Patrol Lights" headgear

[Fixes to Bugs]
  ・Fixed an issue regarding the intended amount of Prismatic Dust being dropped by the Domovoi Ranger enemy.
  ・Adjusted the functionality of the L2 button in Control Types 2 and 4; Lock-On now gets canceled by releasing the L2 button.
  ・Various other bugs have been fixed.

【Ver 1.01 Update Contents】
・The addition of "view all" and "filter" functions for weapon selection
・The addition of the ability to see which difficulty levels of a particular stage that you have cleared in 
Free Mode on the Battle Results Screen
・Options have been expanded when fusing weapons so that secret and unique weapons can also be selected
・The ability to reset personal bests in Challenge Mode
・In the stage “Battle of Baidi Castle,” a glitch that caused the game to freeze when destroying the 
enemy ballista from aboard the transport ship has been fixed
・A bug that prevented battles from starting when the supporting officer has been set to Cao Mao has been fixed
・A bug due to having interim save data where a character is wearing a DLC costume that caused DLC data to be 
deleted and stages to crash when restarted has been fixed
・Bugs that prevented progress in certain stages have been fixed
・The adjustment of the number of enemies that appear in Free Mode only stages
・Additional game balance adjustments and bug fixes

【Contenu de la mise à jour de la version 1.01】
・Ajout des fonctionnalités "Voir tout" et "Filtrer" dans la sélection d'armes
・Ajout de la possibilité de voir quels niveaux de difficulté d'un niveau ont été terminés en Mode Libre sur 
l'écran de résultats de bataille
・Il est désormais possible de sélectionner les armes uniques et secrètes lors de la fusion d'armes
・Il est désormais possible de réinitialiser les meilleurs records personnels dans le Mode Défi
・Dans le niveau "La Bataille du Château de Baidi", un bug qui faisait planter le jeu lorsque la baliste 
ennemie était détruite à partir du navire de transport a été corrigé
・Corrigé un bug qui empêchait les batailles de commencer lorsque l'officier de soutien était Cao Mao
・Corrigé un bug qui supprimait les données de DLC et faisait planter des niveaux lors de la présence de 
données de sauvegarde temporaire contenant un personnage portant une tenue de DLC
・Correction de bugs qui empêchaient de progresser dans certains niveaux
・Ajusté le nombre d'ennemis apparaissant dans les niveaux uniques au Mode Libre
・Correction de bugs supplémentaires et équilibrage du jeu

【Ver.1.01 Update-Inhalte】
・Der Waffenauswahl wurden Funktionen hinzugefügt, mit der alle Waffen angezeigt oder bestimmte Waffen 
gefiltert werden können
・Auf dem Auswahlbildschirm für das Schlachtfeld im Freien Modus können erfolgreich beendete Stages dem 
Schwierigkeitsgrad  nach angezeigt werden
・Die Optionen bei der Waffenfusion wurden erweitert, sodass auch geheime und einzigartige Waffen ausgewählt 
werden können
・Persönliche Bestleistungen können im Herausforderungsmodus zurückgesetzt werden
・In der Stage "Die Schlacht von Burg Baidi" stoppt das Spiel nicht mehr unvorhergesehen, wenn eine feindliche 
Balliste vom Transportschiff aus zerstört wird
・Ein Fehler, der verhinderte, dass der Kampf startet, wenn Cao Mao als unterstützender Offizier ausgewählt wurde, 
wurde behoben
・Ein Fehler, der DLC-Daten löschte und Stages beim Neustart zum Absturz brachte, wenn ein Zwischenspeicherstand 
vorlag, in dem ein Charakter ein DLC-Kostüm trägt, wurde behoben
・Fehler, die den Fortschritt in bestimmten Stages verhinderten, wurden behoben
・Die Anzahl der Feinde, die im Freier Modus erscheinen, wurde angepasst
・Weitere Änderungen, die die Spielbalance betreffen, und Behebungen von Fehlern

доступной в меню XMB и PlayStation®Store.
Все нижеперечисленные возможности дисковой версии также присутствуют в бесплатной версии SingStar™:
- Доступ к магазину SingStore™.
- Загрузка ранее приобретенных материалов (включая песни из дополнений).
- Публикация снимков и видео.
- Просмотр и оценивание опубликованных материалов.

Pääsy online-ominaisuuksiin on poistettu.
Voit jatkaa online-käyttöä SingStar®-pelin ilmaisversiolla,
joka on saatavilla XMB™-valikosta tai PlayStation®Store-verkkokaupasta.
Kaikki alla olevat ominaisuudet ovat valmiina käytettävissä SingStar™-pelin ilmaisversiossa:
- Pääsy SingStore™-verkkokauppaan
- Aiemmin ostetun sisällön (mukaan lukien lisäkappaleet) lataaminen
- Kuvien ja videoiden lähettäminen
- Lähetetyn aineiston katseleminen ja arvosteleminen

Tillgång till onlinefunktioner har tagits bort.
Fortsätt att vara med oss online med gratisversionen av SingStar®
som finns tillgänglig i XMB™-menyn och PlayStation®Store.
Alla nedanstående funktioner från skivversioner av spelet finns redan tillgängliga i gratisversionen av SingStar™:
- Tillgång till SingStore™
- Nedladdning av tidigare köpt innehåll (inklusive låttillägg)
- Uppladdning av foton och videoinspelningar
- Visning och betygsättning av uppladdade media

Adgang til onlinefunktioner er fjernet.
Du kan stadig slutte dig til os online i den gratis version af SingStar®,
der er tilgængelig i XMB™-menuen eller PlayStation®Store.
Alle de diskfunktioner, der beskrives nedenfor, er allerede tilgængelige i den gratis version af SingStar™:
- Adgang til SingStore™
- Download af indhold, du tidligere har købt (inklusive sangtilføjelser)
- Upload af snapshots og videoafspilninger
- Visning og vurdering af uploadede medier

Tilgang til online-funksjoner er fjernet.
Du kan fremdeles gå online med gratisversjonen av SingStar®
som du finner på XMB™-menyen og i PlayStation®Store.
Alt av diskinnhold og -funksjoner nedenfor er allerede tilgjengelig via gratisversjonen av SingStar™:
- Tilgang til SingStore™
- Nedlasting av tidligere kjøpt innhold (deriblant sangtillegg)
- Opplasting av bilder og avspilling av video
- Se og ranger opplastet medieinnhold

Dostęp do funkcji sieciowych został wyłączony.
Dołącz do nas w sieci w bezpłatnej wersji SingStar®,
dostępnej w menu XMB lub PlayStation®Store.
Wszystkie poniższe funkcje dyskowe są już dostępne w bezpłatnej wersji SingStar™:
- Dostęp do SingStore™
- Pobieranie uprzednio zakupionej zawartości (w tym piosenek dodatkowych)
- Przesyłanie zdjęć i klipów
- Wyświetlanie i ocenianie przesłanych materiałów

Alt av diskinnhold og -funksjoner nedenfor er allerede tilgjengelig via gratisversjonen av SingStar™:
- Tilgang til SingStore™
- Nedlasting av tidligere kjøpt innhold (deriblant sangtillegg)
- Opplasting av bilder og avspilling av video
- Se og ranger opplastet medieinnhold

Dostęp do funkcji sieciowych został wyłączony.
Dołącz do nas w sieci w bezpłatnej wersji SingStar®,
dostępnej w menu XMB lub PlayStation®Store.
Wszystkie poniższe funkcje dyskowe są już dostępne w bezpłatnej wersji SingStar™:
- Dostęp do SingStore™
- Pobieranie uprzednio zakupionej zawartości (w tym piosenek dodatkowych)
- Przesyłanie zdjęć i klipów
- Wyświetlanie i ocenianie przesłanych materiałów

O acesso aos recursos online foi removido.
Continue a entrar online na versão gratuita de SingStar®,
disponível no menu XMB™ ou na PlayStation®Store.
Todos os recursos do disco abaixo já estão disponíveis na versão gratuita do SingStar™:
- Acesso à SingStore™
- Baixar conteúdo adquirido previamente (incluindo complementos de músicas)
- Envio de instantâneos e reproduções de vídeo
- Visualização e classificação de mídia enviada

特定の状況下で一部のスキルが修得できなくなる不具合を修正いたしました。
周回プレイにおいて「渦巻く世界の狭間」の報酬が入手できなくなる不具合を修正いたしました。
キーコンフィグの設定により一部動作の入力判定に影響を及ぼす不具合を修正いたしました。
屋根裏部屋で特定の本を読む際、エンディングパターンを任意で選択できるようになりました。
一部のアイテムやスキルの効果について調整および修正を行いました。
メルセデスのサイファースキルの消費PPを軽減いたしました。
メルセデスの通常弾クリティカル発生時にPPが回復するようになりました。
ステージ中のマンドラゴラの出現確率を上方調整いたしました。
その他、表示や動作の不具合修正および、操作性の向上や機能の快適化などシステム周りの改善を行いました。

アップデート内容詳細については公式サイトをご覧ください。

- Visning og vurdering af uploadede medier

changelogs.content:
・今回アップデートされる選手能力データは、2011年度
　8月下旬時点のペナントレースを基に作成されたデータとなります。

・このアップデートを適用すると適用前に各モードで保存した
　試合の中断セーブデータが無効になります。

・なお、「プロ野球スピリッツ 2011」の選手能力アップデートは今回で終了となります。

【Ver 1.01 Update Contents】
・The addition of "view all" and "filter" functions for weapon selection
・The addition of the ability to see which difficulty levels of a particular stage that you have cleared in 
Free Mode on the Battle Results Screen
・Options have been expanded when fusing weapons so that secret and unique weapons can also be selected
・The ability to reset personal bests in Challenge Mode
・In the stage “Battle of Baidi Castle,” a glitch that caused the game to freeze when destroying the 
enemy ballista from aboard the transport ship has been fixed
・A bug that prevented battles from starting when the supporting officer has been set to Cao Mao has been fixed
・A bug due to having interim save data where a character is wearing a DLC costume that caused DLC data to be 
deleted and stages to crash when restarted has been fixed
・Bugs that prevented progress in certain stages have been fixed
・The adjustment of the number of enemies that appear in Free Mode only stages
・Additional game balance adjustments and bug fixes

【Contenu de la mise à jour de la version 1.01】
・Ajout des fonctionnalités "Voir tout" et "Filtrer" dans la sélection d'armes
・Ajout de la possibilité de voir quels niveaux de difficulté d'un niveau ont été terminés en Mode Libre sur 
l'écran de résultats de bataille
・Il est désormais possible de sélectionner les armes uniques et secrètes lors de la fusion d'armes
・Il est désormais possible de réinitialiser les meilleurs records personnels dans le Mode Défi
・Dans le niveau "La Bataille du Château de Baidi", un bug qui faisait planter le jeu lorsque la baliste 
ennemie était détruite à partir du navire de transport a été corrigé
・Corrigé un bug qui empêchait les batailles de commencer lorsque l'officier de soutien était Cao Mao
・Corrigé un bug qui supprimait les données de DLC et faisait planter des niveaux lors de la présence de 
données de sauvegarde temporaire contenant un personnage portant une tenue de DLC
・Correction de bugs qui empêchaient de progresser dans certains niveaux
・Ajusté le nombre d'ennemis apparaissant dans les niveaux uniques au Mode Libre
・Correction de bugs supplémentaires et équilibrage du jeu

【Ver.1.01 Update-Inhalte】
・Der Waffenauswahl wurden Funktionen hinzugefügt, mit der alle Waffen angezeigt oder bestimmte Waffen 
gefiltert werden können
・Auf dem Auswahlbildschirm für das Schlachtfeld im Freien Modus können erfolgreich beendete Stages dem 
Schwierigkeitsgrad  nach angezeigt werden
・Die Optionen bei der Waffenfusion wurden erweitert, sodass auch geheime und einzigartige Waffen ausgewählt 
werden können
・Persönliche Bestleistungen können im Herausforderungsmodus zurückgesetzt werden
・In der Stage "Die Schlacht von Burg Baidi" stoppt das Spiel nicht mehr unvorhergesehen, wenn eine feindliche 
Balliste vom Transportschiff aus zerstört wird
・Ein Fehler, der verhinderte, dass der Kampf startet, wenn Cao Mao als unterstützender Offizier ausgewählt wurde, 
wurde behoben
・Ein Fehler, der DLC-Daten löschte und Stages beim Neustart zum Absturz brachte, wenn ein Zwischenspeicherstand 
vorlag, in dem ein Charakter ein DLC-Kostüm trägt, wurde behoben
・Fehler, die den Fortschritt in bestimmten Stages verhinderten, wurden behoben
・Die Anzahl der Feinde, die im Freier Modus erscheinen, wurde angepasst
・Weitere Änderungen, die die Spielbalance betreffen, und Behebungen von Fehlern

【Ver.1.04　アップデート内容】
・武器の鍛錬で、秘蔵武器とユニーク武器も鍛錬の対象として選べるよう機能を拡張
・チャレンジモードの自己ベストを初期化する機能を追加
・オンラインプレイ時、ゲストの操作武将と同じ武将を護衛武将に設定できない不具合を修正
・オンラインプレイ時、ゲストが離脱後にホストがそのまま戦闘開始をすると停止することがある不具合を修正
・「白帝城の戦い」にて、移動船から敵の弩砲を破壊した際に停止することがある不具合を修正
・護衛武将に「曹髦」を設定した場合、戦闘が開始しないことがある不具合を修正
・フリーモード限定のシナリオで、出現する敵の数を調整
・その他、ゲームバランスの調整といくつかの不具合を修正

changelogs.content:
Ver. 1.01
Important Notice
When using a version of "DYNASTY WARRIORS 7 Empires" for which this update has not been applied (Ver. 1.00),
 please refrain from loading play data or system data that was created after applying this update.
 (Save data that was created before applying the update can be used without issue even after applying the update.)

The following features were added:
 - Test Battle was added to Edit Mode.
  (Stratagems can be used for testing, but Plots cannot be selected.)
 - The number of colors that can be selected for hair in Edit Mode has been expanded to 256.
 - Strengthened the influence of play histories recorded by created officers.
  (The content of play history data is not changed from that of Ver. 1.00.)
 - The following options have been added to the initial settings for Empire Mode:
  (The options can be used after clearing Empire Mode.)
   - Randomization of NPC default Fame.
   - Basic Fame level for created NPC officers.
 - Added the Strategy command "Depart".
 (The command can only be used when you are affiliated with a force as a subordinate. Rulers cannot use it.)
 - The progress of missions is now displayed in the mission info of the Strategy screen.
 - For NPC forces, the NPC's that take on positions such as Strategists and Marshals will now change.
 - When switching the camera at your Abode, the camera's previous position will now be remembered.
 - Added functionality to the L2 button to enable players to give orders to their entire force during battle.
  (This can only be used in situations for which the command "Give Orders" can be used.)
 - Added General Order to the "Give Orders" command on the Information Screen during battle.
 - Reduced the possibility of sworn siblings and spouses becoming a commander during battle.
 - Adjusted the amount that attack power is raised for the Stratagems "Immovable" and "Peerless".
 - "Meat Buns" now appear when defeating enemies during Surprise Attacks.
 - Increased the number of events in which allied NPC officers speak lines.
 - When captured officers are released, they will now return to their former forces if possible.
 - Adjusted conversations that occur as a result of Friendship levels.
The following issues were corrected:
 - Corrected an issue in which under certain conditions the game would stop or could not be advanced during the Strategy Phase
 - Corrected an issue in which under certain conditions the game would stop during battle.
 - Corrected an issue in which the faces of officers were not displayed for conversations during the Strategy Phase.
 - Corrected an issue in which ability values were incorrectly increased when using "Unlock Items".
 - Corrected an issue in which, when the player received weapon attacks that latch onto the player,
    such as standard great axe attacks, such weapons were not displayed correctly.
 - Corrected a number of other graphical issues.

Fixed spanish translation of DOWNLOAD SAVE GAME
Disallow game clip sharing if chat restrictions are in place
Fixed beeps when quitting during sign in dialog
Removed santamatch from single player and coop multiplayer

・修正於冒險者公會解除技能「額外口袋」時，

・修正連線至線上遊玩時，將取得難度「究極」

・修正裝備效果「大雪山」相關的問題。

・調整因游標所衍生的選取優先順序。
・修正播放BGM時因延遲所產生的問題。

【從Ver1.06之前的版本進行更新時的注意事項】
為了在保存資料內預留行囊名稱的存取空間，
寺院中「骸骨」的保管數量上限已由32個修改至28個。
因應此項變動，系統將自動刪除第29個以後的骸骨，
請目前骸骨持有數為29個以上的玩家，先至「迦南神殿」進行復活或埋葬，
將骸骨持有數減少至28個以下後，再將遊戲版本升級至1.09，
或是進行跨平台存檔轉移。

・일부 효과음이 재생되지 않는 오류를 수정하였습니다.
・모험자 길드에서 '엑스트라 포켓'스킬을 해제할 때
　단축키 할당이 해제되지 않는 오류를 수정하였습니다.
・특정 조건하에서 매칭이 되지 않는 오류를 수정하였습니다.
・인터넷 연결 시 '얼티멋'난이도의 탈리스만을 취득하는 오류를 수정하였습니다.
・장비 효과'대설산'에 관한 오류를 수정하였습니다.
・'리플렉트 미사일'스킬에 관한 오류를 수정하였습니다.
・커서에 의한 클릭 우선순위를 조정하였습니다.
・BGM 재생 시 렉이 발생하는 문제를 수정하였습니다.

【Ver1.06 이전 버전에서 갱신할 시의 주의】
저장 데이터 내에 가방 이름의 저장 영역을 확보하기 위해
사원에서 '뼈' 보관 수를 최대 32개에서 28개로 변경했습니다.
따라서 29개 이후의 뼈는 데이터에서 삭제되기 때문에
뼈를 29개 이상 소지하고 있는 분은 '가나안 사원'에서 부활 및 매장을 하여
뼈 소지 수를 28개 이하로 조정한 후 버전 1.09로 업데이트 혹은 크로스 세이브로
데이터 이행을 해주세요.

・A bug preventing navigation voice selection in Options has been fixed.

[Warning when updating from a patch prior to Version 1.03]
In order to make room in the save data for bag names, the maximum number of skeletons
you can store at the temple has been decreased from 32 to 28. Skeletons stored in slots
29 and above will be deleted from your save data. Before updating to Patch 1.09, players
who have 29 or more skeletons are advised to please visit Canaan Temple where they can
either resurrect or bury excess skeletons to bring their total stock within 28.

Please refer to the official website for details.

・一部効果音が再生されない不具合を修正いたしました。
・冒険者ギルドにて、スキル「エクストラポケット」を解除した際、
　ショートカットの割当てが解除されない不具合を修正いたしました。
・特定の条件下でマッチングが行われない不具合を修正いたしました。
・オンライン接続時に、難易度「ウルティメイト」のタリスマンを
　一部取得してしまう不具合を修正いたしました。
・装備効果「大雪山」に関する不具合を修正いたしました。
・スキル「リフレクトミサイル」に関する不具合を修正いたしました。
・カーソルによるクリックの優先順位を調整いたしました。
・BGM再生にラグが生じる問題を修正いたしました。

【Ver1.06以前のバージョンから更新される際の注意】
セーブデータ内にカバン名の保存領域を確保するため、
寺院での「骨」の保管数を最大32個から28個に変更いたしました。
この変更により、29個目以降の骨はデータから削除されてしまうため、
骨を29個以上所持されている方は、「カナン寺院」にて復活や埋葬を行い
骨の所持数を28個以下にして頂いた上で、バージョン1.09にアップデート、
もしくはクロスセーブでのデータ移行を行って頂きますようお願いいたします。

・A bug preventing navigation voice selection in Options has been fixed.

[Warning when updating from a patch prior to Version 1.06]
In order to make room in the save data for bag names, the maximum number of skeletons
you can store at the temple has been decreased from 32 to 28. Skeletons stored in slots
29 and above will be deleted from your save data. Before updating to Patch 1.09, players
who have 29 or more skeletons are advised to please visit Canaan Temple where they can
either resurrect or bury excess skeletons to bring their total stock within 28.

Please refer to the official website for details.

- Version 1.10:
  
NEW FEATURES:
- A new zero star battle rank has been added. Battles will be much easier for players that 
  just want to focus on story and exploration parts.

- Battle skill animations can now be skipped right from the start. The following options have
  been added:
  - <Default> This is the old default behavior.
  - <Skip always> All skills can always be skipped by holding down the R2 button.
    This also affects monster skills.
  - <Auto skip> All animations are skipped automatically without holding down the R2 button.
    If a new skill is discovered, it will be displayed once, but all follow up animations of the
    same skill are skipped. This affects ally and enemy skills.

IMPROVEMENTS:
- Several help notifications have been added.
  - These notifications only appear in the beginning of the game.
  - A help notification will be displayed in case certain key features of the game are not used,
    such as:
    - many skill stones have been collected but not spent in the upgrade menu.
    - new skill books have not been purchased and studied in a while.
    - new gear has not been purchased, although sufficient coins are available.
    - equipment has not been improved at the blacksmith with collected materials.
    - a reminder that players can switch to the battle menu by pressing the cancel button.
- All vehicles can now also be entered by pressing the SELECT button when standing close to the
  vehicle. This prevents very rare situations where players were no longer able to enter their
  vehicle after landing in very small areas with other interactive objects nearby.
    
BUGFIXES:
- Fixed an issue where the main character did not reappear after changing equipment in very
  populated spots.
- The passive skill "Kamikaze" now works properly in all situations and the damage prediction
  always matches the expected result.
- Fixed an issue where the HP display could become corrupted when fighting an end game boss on
  battle rank 9.
- Fixed a very rare issue that allowed battles with notorious monsters to be initiated while they
  were despawning.
- Fixed an issue at the monster farm that allowed players to change the egg selection while the
  rename requester was spawned. This could lead to the removal of the wrong egg and other side
  effects.
- Fixed several bugs related to the monster house. In case corrupted units are stored in the
  monster house, they will automatically be repaired when loading the save data.
- If a battle was started, while the lottery music was played, the battle music was not played
  at all.
- Fixed a crash that could occur after a trial battle if the speech bubble was not confirmed
  immediately.
- Fixed a bug that could lead to triggering empty battles in the end game dungeon "Cascades of
  Mystery."
- A bag in the "Glimmer Mine" could not be collected if a big character or monster was selected
  as leader.
- Fixed several text typos.
- Other minor or cosmetic improvements and fixes.

The following features have been added:

 - The ability to change music during online play in Conquest Mode.

Peliin on tehty muita korjauksia ja vakausparannuksia

Problemet med att partyprofilfoton försvann i samband med att profilen redigerades har åtgärdats.
Diverse buggfixar och allmänna stabilitetsförbättringar.

Navigér hurtigere rundt mellem sangene ved at gå fra A-Å eller Å-A 
Vi har rettet en fejl, hvor Party-profilbillederne blev fjernet, hvis spilleren redigerede sin profil 
Andre fejlrettelser og generelle forbedringer

Naprawiono błąd polegający na tym, że zdjęcia profilowe imprezy były usuwane w trakcie edytowania profilów.
Inne poprawki błędów i generalna poprawa stabilności.

- Zugang zum SingStore™
- Herunterladen zuvor gekaufter Inhalte (auch Song-Erweiterungen)

- Ansehen und Bewerten hochgeladener Medien

accedendo dal menu XMB™ o da PlayStation®Store.
Tutti i contenuti del disco elencati qui di seguito sono già disponibili nella versione gratuita di SingStar™:
- Accesso a SingStore™
- Download dei contenuti già acquistati (inclusi i brani aggiuntivi)
- Caricamento di istantanee e playback video
- Visualizzazione e valutazione dei media caricati

De toegang tot online-functies is verwijderd.
Je kunt online met ons doorgaan in de gratis versie van SingStar®
die beschikbaar is in het XMB™-menu of de PlayStation®Store.
De volgende disc-functies zijn al beschikbaar via de gratis versie van SingStar®:
- Toegang tot de SingStore®
- Download van eerder gekochte inhoud (inclusief extra nummers)
- Uploaden van foto's en beeldopnamen
- Bekijken en beoordelen van geüploade media

Continua a juntar-te a nós online através da versão gratuita do SingStar®,
disponível no Menu XMB™ ou na PlayStation®Store.

- Acesso à SingStore™
- Transferência de conteúdos comprados anteriormente (incluindo add-ons de canções)
- Envio de fotografias e reproduções de vídeos
- Visualização e classificação de media enviados

доступной в меню XMB и PlayStation®Store.

- Доступ к магазину SingStore™.

- Pääsy SingStore™-verkkokauppaan

- Lähetetyn aineiston katseleminen ja arvosteleminen

- Modo Batalla de dúos añadido

Stabilitätsverbesserungen

Nuove caratteristiche
- Aggiunta la modalità Canzone breve
- Aggiunta la modalità Duetto battaglia

- Registra il nome del giocatore con punteggio più alto
Risoluzione problemi di stabilità
- Migliorata la connessione di SingStar Mic

- Kort nummer-modus toegevoegd

- Modo Canção de Duração Curta adicionado
- Modo Dueto de Combate adicionado

- Memorização do nome do jogador com pontuações mais altas

- Otimização do desempenho e redução de latência do SingStar Mic

- добавлен режим "Короткая песня"
- добавлен режим "Поединок в дуэте"
- красные против синих - отслеживайте результаты команд с помощью списков воспроизведения
- функция запоминания имени игрока, поставившего рекорд
Устранение проблем с нестабильностью
- улучшено соединение с микрофоном SingStar Mic
- оптимизирована производительность микрофона SingStar Mic и уменьшена латентность
- улучшена синхронизация голоса и видеоряда в записанных материалах
- подкорректированы уровни громкости микрофона
- улучшена стабильность в целом, также исправлены небольшие ошибки
